# Haritt Developers

> Haritt Developers is a digital solutions partner for growing businesses, part of Haritt Group (India). We understand before we build: websites and digital experiences, applications and platforms, and custom digital solutions such as enquiry systems and automation. Start with a free First Look: three honest observations about your business online, within 3 working days. Contact: developers@haritt.com

The name is spelled Haritt, with two Ts. People sometimes type Harit Developers; it is the same company. Founders: Harsh Goyal and Pulkit Soni.

- [Haritt Developers · We understand before we build](https://developers.haritt.com/): Haritt Developers is a digital solutions partner for growing businesses in India: websites, apps and custom systems, built after we understand your business. Start with a free First Look.
- [Services](https://developers.haritt.com/services/): Three ways Haritt Developers helps: websites and digital experiences, applications and platforms, and custom digital solutions.
- [Websites & Digital Experiences](https://developers.haritt.com/services/websites/): Business websites, online stores, landing pages and Google profile setup that make people trust you and get in touch.
- [Applications & Platforms](https://developers.haritt.com/services/apps/): Android apps, web apps, customer portals and dashboards. We start with the smallest version worth building, then grow it.
- [Custom Digital Solutions](https://developers.haritt.com/services/custom-solutions/): Enquiry inbox, follow-ups, simple CRM and automation that take repetitive work off your plate, with AI only where it helps.
- [AI & Business Automation](https://developers.haritt.com/services/ai/): Try two working AI demos: an enquiry that routes itself and a customer assistant that answers only from approved information.
- [Our approach](https://developers.haritt.com/approach/): We understand before we build. Five steps: Understand, Discover, Strategize, Create, Improve, and what you see at every stage.
- [Industries](https://developers.haritt.com/industries/): What we usually see and set up for retail stores, clinics, restaurants, coaching institutes, real estate and professional services.
- [Retail & clothing stores](https://developers.haritt.com/industries/retail/): Websites, WhatsApp catalogues and Google profiles for shops that sell through Instagram, WhatsApp and walk-ins.
- [Clinics & healthcare](https://developers.haritt.com/industries/clinics/): Appointment requests, clear clinic websites and Google profiles for doctors, dentists, physios and diagnostic centres.
- [Restaurants & cafés](https://developers.haritt.com/industries/restaurants/): Online menus, table bookings and direct orders for restaurants, cafés, cloud kitchens and caterers.
- [Coaching & education](https://developers.haritt.com/industries/coaching/): Course pages, demo class booking and fee reminders for coaching institutes, tutors and schools.
- [Real estate](https://developers.haritt.com/industries/real-estate/): Property pages, lead tracking and site visit booking for builders, brokers and property consultants.
- [Professional services](https://developers.haritt.com/industries/professional-services/): Credible websites, client intake forms and follow-up systems for CAs, lawyers, consultants and agencies.
- [Work](https://developers.haritt.com/work/): Client projects, products we build and run ourselves, and concept work, each labelled for what it is.
- [HV Reset case study](https://developers.haritt.com/work/hv-reset/): How we turned a simple question, why do daily planners stop working after a week, into a web app and an Android app.
- [Insights](https://developers.haritt.com/insights/): Short, practical concept studies of common business problems and how we would approach them.
- [Free First Look](https://developers.haritt.com/first-look/): A free, written review of your business online: three honest observations within 3 working days. No phone number, no sales calls.
- [Founding Client Programme](https://developers.haritt.com/founding-clients/): Our first three clients work directly with the founders, with introductory pricing and full attention.
- [Engagement & Investment](https://developers.haritt.com/engagement/): How we work out your investment: the factors, what you receive, engagement models and care plans. No packages, no surprises.
- [Technology](https://developers.haritt.com/technology/): The technology and practices we use in real projects and our own products: stack, integrations, AI, security and data protection.
- [About](https://developers.haritt.com/about/): Haritt Developers is a digital solutions partner for growing businesses, and part of Haritt Group, India.
- [Contact](https://developers.haritt.com/contact/): Talk to Haritt Developers. Get a free First Look or send us your requirement. We reply within 3 working days.
- [FAQ](https://developers.haritt.com/faq/): Answers to common questions about working with Haritt Developers: cost, timelines, payments, revisions, ownership and support.
- [Terms of service](https://developers.haritt.com/terms/): The terms for working with Haritt Developers: scope, revisions, ownership, responsibilities and liability.
- [Payment and refund](https://developers.haritt.com/payments/): Haritt Developers payment steps, late payment, cancellation and refund policy.
